title: Torrential School Operations Suite
description: Hero title slide with school image and product tagline
speakerNotes:
Open with the name and tagline. TSOS is an offline-first, browser-based SaaS platform built specifically for African schools.

- Emphasise: works on any device, no app install, built for Ghana
- Set the tone: this is not a generic school system — it is purpose-built for this market
- TSOS v1.0 is live and deployed in production

title: The Problem
description: Four core pain points: manual registers, no audit trail, zero visibility, connectivity gap
speakerNotes:
The status quo in African schools is paper-first.

- Attendance registers are physical books — lost, forged, and transcribed by hand daily
- Fee collection happens in exercise books with no receipt trail or reconciliation
- Principals have no dashboard — they cannot see what is happening across their school
- Most cloud-only systems simply do not work when the internet goes down — which is often
- This is a structural problem, not a temporary one

title: The Scale of the Opportunity
description: Market size: 300,000+ schools Sub-Saharan Africa, 35,000+ Ghana, under 5% digitized
speakerNotes:
The market is enormous and almost entirely untouched.

- Over 300,000 primary and secondary schools across Sub-Saharan Africa
- Ghana alone has more than 35,000 basic schools — our beachhead market
- Less than 5% of these schools use any digital management system
- Each school wastes 30+ hours per week on manual admin that software would eliminate
- At 500 GHS/month per school, even 1% of Ghana's market is 1,750 schools = GHS 875,000/month

title: Our Solution
description: TSOS offline-first SaaS — works offline, any device, no install, built for Ghana
speakerNotes:
TSOS solves the connectivity problem at the architecture level — not as an afterthought.

- IndexedDB stores all data locally — the app works whether or not the internet is on
- When connectivity returns, data syncs automatically in the background
- Runs entirely in the browser — no app store, no installation, no IT department needed
- Built specifically for the Ghanaian curriculum, grading system, and billing (GHS + Paystack)
- Contrast with competitors: most are either cloud-only or require Windows installs

title: Core Modules
description: Seven integrated modules: Students, Attendance, Finance, Academics, Staff, Admin, Stock & Inventory
speakerNotes:
Seven modules, one platform — no integrations, no data silos.

- Students: full lifecycle from enrollment through graduation
- Attendance: daily student register and GPS-verified teacher check-in
- Finance: fee collection, expenditure tracking, and Paystack subscription billing
- Academics: score entry with 5 components, automated report cards, class timetable
- Staff: payroll with Ghana PAYE, discipline log, and announcements
- Admin: school settings, operational calendar, multi-school management
- Stock & Inventory: item catalogue, intake/issue/adjustment movements, periodic stock-take, low-stock alerts

title: Offline-First Architecture
description: How the sync engine works: IndexedDB, pull/push queue, sync status indicator
speakerNotes:
This is our technical moat — the offline-first architecture is not trivial to build.

- Step 1: On first load (online), all school data pulls from server into IndexedDB
- Step 2: All reads come from IndexedDB via useLiveQuery — instant, zero latency
- Step 3: All writes go to IndexedDB first, then queue a sync operation
- Step 4: When online, the sync engine pushes the queue and pulls fresh data
- The sync status is shown live in the sidebar: Online / Offline / Syncing / Pending
- A 20-second safety timeout ensures the dashboard always loads even if sync fails

title: Student Management
description: Enrollment, auto-IDs, passport photos, ID cards, fee waivers, promotion wizard, CSV import
speakerNotes:
The student module covers the full academic lifecycle.

- Student numbers auto-generated: school code + year + sequence (e.g. GA260001)
- Passport photos upload via secure presigned URL to MinIO object storage
- ID cards print in a 3-column credit-card-size grid — no external tool needed
- Fee waivers (school, feeding, bus) shown as coloured badges in the student list
- Promotion wizard: 3-step dialog for single class or bulk end-of-year promotion
- CSV bulk import with fuzzy class name matching — handles 500+ students at once

title: Finance & Billing
description: Fee collection, expenditure, Paystack billing, real-time dashboard metrics, payroll
speakerNotes:
Finance is the most critical module for school owners — and the one that drives adoption.

- Three fee types tracked per student: school fees, bus fees, canteen/feeding
- Expenditure by category: salaries, utilities, supplies, maintenance, other
- Real-time dashboard shows: collected vs expected, arrears, net cash, collection rate
- Paystack popup handles subscription renewal — no card storage, HMAC webhook verification
- Staff payroll: Ghana PAYE (GRA 2024 tax bands) + SSNIT employee and employer contributions
- Cancellation, grace periods, and auto-deactivation all built in

title: Teacher Portal
description: Separate teacher login, score entry, GPS check-in, timetable, announcements
speakerNotes:
Teachers have a completely separate experience from the school admin.

- Credentials generated by the school admin — password shown once, then bcrypt-hashed
- Score entry covers all 5 components: classwork, class test, homework, project, exam
- Total and grade (Ghana A1–F9 scale) computed automatically, remarks overridable
- GPS check-in uses haversine validation against the school's configured coordinates
- Timetable: homeroom teachers see all their class slots; subject teachers see only their subjects
- Announcement inbox with unread count badge and social share buttons

title: Report Cards
description: Ghana BECE grading (A1–F9), 5-component scores, class position, printable per-student
speakerNotes:
Report cards are automated — no manual calculation or formatting needed.

- 5 assessment components: classwork (10), class test (20), homework (5), project (5), exam (60)
- Grades computed automatically using Ghana's A1–F9 BECE scale
- Class position calculated by comparing each student's total against all classmates — one batch query
- School admin selects term and academic year — instantly generates the full report
- Admin can view and print any student's report from the students page
- Teacher portal shows the same data from the teacher's perspective

title: Multi-School Architecture
description: Super admin dashboard, per-school isolation, slug-based routing, role-based access
speakerNotes:
TSOS is designed to operate as a multi-tenant platform from day one.

- A super admin account manages all schools: activation, pricing, subscription status
- Each school is fully isolated — data never leaks between schools
- URLs use school slug (not numeric IDs) for clean, secure routing
- Three roles: super admin (platform), school admin (one school), teacher (classroom only)
- This architecture enables district-level or national contracts — one platform, thousands of schools

title: Business Model
description: 500 GHS/month flat SaaS fee, 5% discount for 12+ months, grace period, zero transaction fees
speakerNotes:
Simple, predictable, scalable pricing.

- Base price: 500 GHS per school per month — set by super admin, adjustable per market
- One volume discount tier: 5% off for 12+ month commitments
- 3-day grace period after expiry before auto-deactivation — fair to schools, automatic for us
- No per-transaction fees on student payments — schools keep 100% of what they collect
- Revenue model: every new school adds a clean 500 GHS/month to MRR
- 1,000 schools = GHS 500,000/month (~USD 33,000/month at current rates)

title: Go-to-Market
description: Three channels: direct sales, education office partnerships, word of mouth. Three expansion stages.
speakerNotes:
We have three parallel acquisition channels and a clear geographic expansion roadmap.

- Direct sales: school proprietors and owners — highest intent, direct relationship, fastest close
- Education office partnerships: District Education Offices handle procurement for clusters of schools
- Word of mouth: teachers talk to teachers — low CAC, high trust, organic referrals
- Stage 1: private schools across Ghana — highest digital readiness, English instruction, fastest adopters
- Stage 2: expand to public schools via GES partnership and rural districts nationwide
- Stage 3: West Africa — Nigeria, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal — same architecture, localised billing

title: Technology Stack
description: React/Vite/Dexie frontend, Express/PostgreSQL backend, MinIO on Namecheap VPS, Docker Compose
speakerNotes:
The stack is modern, open-source, and deployed on an external VPS for full control and low cost.

- Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Dexie.js for IndexedDB, shadcn/ui components
- Backend: Node.js 24, Express 5, PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, Zod validation
- Offline layer: IndexedDB write queue, pull/push sync engine, online/offline detection
- Storage: MinIO self-hosted on Namecheap VPS with AWS SigV4 signing and an upload proxy route
- Deployment: Docker Compose on Namecheap VPS with Nginx reverse proxy — full infrastructure control
- Full TypeScript coverage across all packages via pnpm monorepo + OpenAPI spec-first codegen

title: Traction
description: Live on production VPS — multi-school, offline sync, Paystack, photos, report cards, payroll, stock all verified
speakerNotes:
This is not a prototype. TSOS is live and running in production today.

- Two schools fully operational: Greenfield Academy and Sunridge Primary
- Offline sync confirmed end-to-end: pull on first load, queue writes, push on reconnect
- Paystack subscription renewal, cancellation, and HMAC webhook verification all tested live
- Photo upload to MinIO with SigV4 signing — passport photos visible and printable on ID cards
- Teacher score entry flows through to printable report cards with correct BECE grades
- Ghana PAYE payroll with SSNIT deductions processed in confirmed payroll runs
- Stock & Inventory module live: catalogue, movements, stock-take, and low-stock alerts verified

- TSOS is not just a school management tool — it is the infrastructure layer for African education admin
- The way schools track students, pay teachers, collect fees, and report results
- We are building for the next 100,000 schools across West Africa
- The platform is live, the architecture is proven, and the market is wide open
